gold.user: As a project manager, I want to update the custom fields of an issue in Jira to reflect the latest project requirements.
gold.ideal: The API should successfully update the specified fields of the issue and return a confirmation response.

gold.user: As a system administrator, I need to update the properties of a specific entity type to ensure that our migration process is aligned with the new configurations.
gold.ideal: The API should update the properties for the given entity type and return a success message with the updated values.

gold.user: As a developer, I want to search for existing workflow rules to analyze their compatibility with the new system before migration.
